name: UNLiFE
source: The Devos Bloodline is said to be cursed, but you had no idea just how cursed it was. You play as a great descendant of Devos, his direct lineage, but what happened to your family to cause such misfortune? Who started this never-ending curse, and is there a way to break free from it? Your father has tasked you with learning your family history in a curious way.. He wants you to go back to your old apartment, the one you know for certain is haunted by an Entity, perhaps multiple Entities..
translation: 相传德沃斯家族的血脉背负着可怕的诅咒，但你此前根本不知道这道诅咒究竟有多么深重。你将扮演德沃斯的直系后裔——你的家族究竟遭遇过怎样的变故，才会招致如此惨重的厄运？是谁设下了这道永无止境的诅咒，又是否有办法彻底摆脱它的束缚？父亲以一种颇为离奇的方式向你下达了查明家族往事的嘱托……他要你重返曾经居住过的旧公寓——那间你无比确信正盘踞着某个、甚至不止一个诡异存在的凶宅……
